settings.heading: Built from real shop needs. Designed for better work.
settings.lead: Two engineers, one messy fabrication shop and a storage problem nobody had solved well. TOOSA is what we built instead, and since 2023 it has grown into a Canadian community of more than a thousand workshops.

settings.small: founded by two engineers in Richmond, BC

settings.heading: It started with our own shop.
Two engineers with a storage problem
settings.text:
Founded by two engineers with a shared passion for creativity and high quality craftsmanship. Between us: metallurgy and mechatronics, and years spent working in precision CNC machining, 3D printing and automotive parts manufacturing.

Throughout our careers we kept running into the same challenge: working professionals need affordable tool storage that still looks stylish and professional. In 2023 we founded TOOSA to build it, for professionals at every level.
settings.caption: The founders

settings.heading: The storage we wanted didn't exist. So we built it.
settings.text: TOOSA didn't start with a business plan. It started with a messy metal fabrication shop that needed to be organized. When we renovated our own workspace, we went looking for tool storage that was high quality, functional and built around the way we actually worked.
settings.beats:
What we found was frustrating :: Expensive, low quality, or not flexible enough. Some quotes were in the $30,000 to $40,000 range for a setup we believed should cost a fraction of that.
So we built our own :: Integrated work surfaces, easy-access pegboards, concealed upper storage and a layout that kept everything organized and within reach.
It transformed the workspace :: Cleaner, more organized, more professional. We could find our tools when we needed them.
People started asking :: Where did the storage come from? That got us thinking.
settings.caption: From humble beginnings

settings.heading: Quality. Value. Flexibility.
settings.lead: Everything we build comes back to three principles, and one habit: we listen before we design.

settings.title: Quality
settings.text: Heavy-gauge welded steel, full-extension ball-bearing slides and a textured powder coat that shrugs off brake clean and oil. Built to work hard every day.

settings.title: Value
settings.text: Commercial-grade storage at a price a real business or homeowner can justify, with monthly payments through RBC when that helps.

settings.title: Flexibility
settings.text: Modular by design. Start with one unit and add lockers, hutches, benches, lighting and foam later. They bolt straight on.

settings.title: We listen. Then we build.
settings.text: Customer feedback drives what we develop and improve. We hear what works, what does not, and what would make your workspace better.

settings.heading: What if everyone could have a workspace like this?
settings.text:
We posted one of our units on Facebook Marketplace just to see what would happen. The response was immediate. We woke up to more inquiries than we expected, and that was the moment we realized there was a real gap in the market.

Professionals, businesses, mechanics, fabricators, tradespeople and DIYers were all looking for the same thing we were: high-quality tool storage that doesn't cost a fortune and doesn't lock you into one configuration.
settings.stat1_small: more inquiries than we expected from one listing
settings.stat2_small: first product line launched with that idea at the centre
settings.caption: The first listing

settings.heading: A workbench is where ideas become things
settings.text:
A workbench is more than a piece of furniture. It's the canvas where your hands bring ideas to life, whether you're crafting, repairing or building. We build storage that inspires confidence and keeps your tools within reach, so you can focus on your craft.

Our mission is simple: high-quality, functional storage that meets the needs of seasoned professionals and budding enthusiasts alike, without breaking the bank. We listen to our customers, keep improving the products and make sure you have the best solutions to reach your goals.
settings.quote: Thank you for being part of our journey. Together, let's build a better workspace.

settings.heading: From one listing to a national customer base.

settings.title: TOOSA is founded
settings.text: Two friends of more than 18 years, both engineers, decide to build the tool storage they could not find: welded steel, modular, fairly priced.

settings.title: One unit on Facebook Marketplace
settings.text: Posted to see what would happen. By morning there were more inquiries than expected, and the gap in the market was obvious.

settings.title: First product line launches
settings.text: Rolling tool chests, hutches, side lockers and foam, sold from Richmond, BC and delivered across Canada.

settings.title: Calgary joins the map
settings.text: A partnership with My Tool Shop brings TOOSA storage to Alberta, with local pickup and a place to see the units.

settings.title: 1,000+ customers and counting
settings.text: Garages, service bays, fabrication shops and retail floors across the country, plus shop air, lighting, engraving and custom foam from one supplier.
